what: the clear planet, transit + three eclipses + night side, retrieved from twelve realisations of the noise with 100 live points, and the first eight again with 400, and with slice sampling alone at 56 steps a point; and all twelve again after the chemistry table was interpolated by a monotone cubic in [M/H] and C/O; and 28 further noise draws (seeds 33 to 60) with the cubic
command: node tools/examples/ariel_retrieval.mjs clear seed=N only=joint out=FILE, N = 21 to 32; again with nlive=400 calls=1200000 for N = 21 to 28; again with method=slice slice=56 calls=2500000; all twelve again on 2026-11-22 with the default command and the cubic interpolation; N = 33 to 60 on 2026-11-22 with the default command
chemistry: runs, runs400 and runsSlice were made on 2026-11-21 with [M/H] and C/O interpolated linearly in the chemistry table (equilibrium(..., { linear: true }) in src/core/chemistry.js); runsSmooth on 2026-11-22 with the monotone cubic that is now the default. Data and fit use the same interpolation in each set. runsMore: 2026-11-22, the cubic; seconds are wall-clock with fourteen fits sharing the machine (one includes a pause)
